::: {#exm-hers-pooled-ttest}
#### Pooled t-test of baseline glucose in HERS

In HERS, the two groups have nearly equal sizes
(`r length(glucose_ht)` and `r length(glucose_placebo)`)
and nearly equal standard deviations
(`r round(sd(glucose_ht), 1)` and `r round(sd(glucose_placebo), 1)` mg/dL),
so the pooled test gives almost the same result as Welch's test
in @exm-hers-ttest:

```{r}
t.test(glucose_ht, glucose_placebo, var.equal = TRUE)
```

:::
